notes.title: Patch 2.3

tags.feature: Added explanatory phrases in the loading with the ability to read them all. These are important tips to better enjoy the game;
Added a lot of sounds to the game interface;

tags.bug: Fixed mouse click behavior in tasting when no potion was selected;
Fixed some bugs that lead to incorrect display of names in the wrong language;

tags.feature: Activated the multiple potions perk to produce multiple potions simultaneously. You can unlock it as usual in the Knowledge activity. This perk is very strong because you can produce multiple potions using just the time of one, the important thing is that you have multiple ingredients ready to use;
Now in the purchase activity the ingredients are colored in green or red depending on the ingredients handled by the supplier;
We have graphically reversed the percentage experience with the probability of success of the saboteurs. It is now clear what the success rates are;

tags.bug: Fixes and general improvements to the milestones, especially when completed;
Fixed graphic bug in the tools after the installment purchase of the tools;
Many minor fixes.

notes.title: Patch 2.2

tags.feature: Now in the book of formulas you can use the search bar to better find your formulas;
Activities and helpers can now be dragged from day to day on the board. Before, you had to delete them and reinsert them from the top panel;

tags.bug: Fixed a few bugs when using multiple helpers. These bugs mostly happened using presets when multiple helpers were present;

tags.feature: Enhanced the mechanism of hiring a firing the helpers;

tags.bug: Fixed a few minor bugs.

notes.title: Patch 2.1

tags.feature: Added the "Balance Panel" it shows a detailed overview of gain and costs. It can be reached by clicking the "coins icon" in the bottom right corner;
Added the possibility to buy instruments in installments. They can be repaid in 10-week installments;

tags.bug: Fixed the graphical aspect of the antidots in the tasting activity;
Fixed in general the behavior of some events;
Fixed an issue on the Tournament event, which showed unclear bonuses. Other minor fixes in Tournaments;

tags.bug: Fixed the movement of the clients inside the shop;
Fixed some minor graphical bugs while entering the tutorial;

tags.feature: Updated the music in the "End Game" screen;
Updated some mouse-over texts, and added new ones;
Sabotages are now active;

tags.bug: Many minor bug fixes.

tags.balance_change: Updated the Stress system. Now is less invasive. Remember that 2 activities are still the optimal number to be placed in each day without the related perks;

notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.content:
Here is a list of the bugs fixed with [b]patch 1.3[/b]:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the interface to disappear after learning a perk. And it did not allow the game to proceed.
Now you can load the save that was causing you this problem and continue your game!
[*] Fixed a visual bug in the alchemist summary panel and in the tools panel;
[*] Other minor fixes.
[/list]

Special thanks to the user who sent us the log to better recognize the error he had identified (new user than yesterday).

We are still working on all the other feedbacks and bugs.
If you have any consideration or you find a bug, please post it here or in the Steam discussions and we will do our best to solve them. Thank you!

tags.bug: Fixed a bug that caused the interface to disappear after learning a perk.
Fixed a visual bug in the alchemist summary panel and in the tools panel;
Other minor fixes.

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content:
Here is a list of the bugs fixed with [b]patch 1.2[/b]:
[list]
[*] Fixed the bug that in late stages caused the interruption of the activity and led to not being able to proceed in the game;
[*] The selling activity has been improved. Until now, not satisfying customers could lead to progressively fewer and fewer customers down to zero. This was intentional, but it resulted in the loss of the game. We have entered a minimum customer limit. So that we always have at least one or more loyal customers to sell potions to.
To maintain a high reputation we recommend that you sell potions with the confirmed (green) label, when possible entertain and explain the potion to the customer and sell potions with low toxicity. The toxicity can be deduced during the tasting, or from the color of the potion once the double green label is reached.
[/list]

Special thanks to the user who sent us the log to better recognize the error he had identified.

We are still working on all the other feedbacks and bugs.
[i]If you have any consideration or you find a bug, please post it here or in the Steam discussions and we will do our best to solve them. Thank you![/i]

tags.bug: Fixed the bug that in late stages caused the interruption of the activity and led to not being able to proceed in the game;

The selling activity has been improved. Until now, not satisfying customers could lead to progressively fewer and fewer customers down to zero. This was intentional, but it resulted in the loss of the game. We have entered a minimum customer limit. So that we always have at least one or more loyal customers to sell potions to.

notes.title: Patch 1.1

tags.bug: Fixed a bug in the bulletin board that considered altered states such as stress to be continuous;

Thanks to your feedback, we have improved how stress works. Now there are no more situations in which the system forces you to enter activities that would bring you to be more and more stressed. This caused the flames icon effect that many of you saw on the bulletin board;
Improved movement of how the burnout/stress updates;
Improved the functioning of the scroll views.

notes.title: Patch 1.0

tags.bug: Fixed the error that resulted in the game crashing when quickly clicking the tutorial button returning to the main menu;
Fixed partner being liquidated and leading to a bug on save slots;
Temporarily disabled the possibility of liquidating the partner. It led to some graphics bugs that we are currently fixing.
Fixed the bug on Vignette Rockmoss, when opening the in-game panel, the relevant values were not displayed;
Fixed a minor display issue when completing some milestones.
